input: Sign up for a community beekeeping taster day

gold.taskTitle: Sign Up for a Community Beekeeping Taster Day
gold.taskDescription: Find and register for a community beekeeping taster day event.

questions.title: Which country and city are you based in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to find relevant local beekeeping taster events.

questions.title: Do you have a specific date range in mind?
questions.description: Determine when the user wants to attend so results can be filtered by availability.

questions.title: Have you already found a specific event or organisation?
questions.description: Check whether the user has a particular beekeeping club or event already in mind.

questions.title: Is this your very first time around bees?
questions.description: Understand the user's experience level to help match the right beginner-friendly event.

questions.title: Are you open to travelling a set maximum distance?
questions.description: Establish how far the user is willing to travel to attend the taster day.

questions.title: Do you have a budget limit for the registration fee?
questions.description: Find out if cost is a constraint when selecting which taster day to sign up for.

questions.title: Will you be attending alone or bringing someone with you?
questions.description: Clarify the number of places needed so the sign-up covers everyone attending.
